headline: Peter Cullen, Who Voiced Optimus Prime in ‘Transformers,’ Dies at 85
context: He voiced the main protagonist of the “Transformers” franchise on television and in blockbuster films for more than four decades. He also had success as Eeyore in “Winnie the Pooh” cartoons.

sources.name: The New York Times
